question: Since the 50% Mn-doped LNO delivered more capacity than the 10% Mn sample, how much more heat did it release in the thermal tests?
rendered:
The document states that the 10% Mn-doped LNO sample released 901.4 J/g in the thermal decomposition tests, while the 50% Mn-doped LNO sample released 485.7 J/g. 

To find out how much more heat the 50% Mn-doped sample released, we need to subtract the amount of heat released by the 50% Mn-doped sample from the amount released by the 10% Mn-doped sample.

901.4 J/g - 485.7 J/g = 415.7 J/g

So, the 50% Mn-doped LNO sample released 415.7 J/g less heat than the 10% Mn-doped sample.
